mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% (as of t-1mo) predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns by reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, as lower rates increase the present value of future earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% (as of t-1mo) signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below their 3-month moving averages indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both below 3-month MA) fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) indicates economic weakness that dampens corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days during labor market contraction regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100.0 (as of t-2mo) indicates strengthening supply-side activity that supports corporate profits, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through improved earnings visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 100.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1200 thousand units (as of t-3mo) signal weak residential construction, a leading indicator of slowing consumer demand that predicts negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1200 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Slow GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized growth < 1.0%) indicates economic deceleration that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days during slow-growth regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 annualized growth < 1.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls below 150.0 thousand (as of t-1mo) indicate labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending power, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days through near-term earnings pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS < 150.0 over any 3-year rolling window.
